title: One character, four bytes
objective: Find one Unicode scalar that is one grapheme, two UTF-16 code units, and four UTF-8 bytes.
graphDescription: The same scalar sequence is encoded as UTF-8 and UTF-16 before counting.
hints: Characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane need a UTF-16 surrogate pair.
Emoji are a familiar place to look for supplementary characters.
Try 🧩 or another single emoji without a variation selector.
explanation: A supplementary scalar is still one Unicode scalar and often one grapheme, but UTF-16 stores it as a surrogate pair while UTF-8 uses four bytes.
